kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاقل (form VI)
# نَتَعَاقَلُ (nataʕāqalu) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
# نَتَعَاقَلَ (nataʕāqala) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
# نَتَعَاقَلْ (nataʕāqal) /na.ta.ʕaː.qal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
